name: Ilvareth Dusksong
languages: Common plus five other languages, Elvish, Deep Speech

abilities.name: Living Shadow
abilities.description: While in dim light or darkness, when Ilvareth takes the Dash or Disengage action, Ilvareth is invisible and leaves no tracks, and when it takes the Dash or Disengage action it can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that is in dim light or darkness.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: Ilvareth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Misty Step (3/Day) (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: Ilvareth casts *Misty Step*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

abilities.name: Protective Magic (3/Day) (Reaction)
abilities.description: When Ilvareth is hit by an attack roll, Ilvareth casts *Shield* in response, gaining a +5 bonus to AC until the start of its next turn, including against the triggering attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ilvareth makes four Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
Ilvareth casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17): - **At will:** *Detect Magic*, *Detect Thoughts*, *Disguise Self*, *Invisibility*, *Light*, *Mage Armor*, *Mage Hand*, *Prestidigitation*
**2/day each:** *Fly*, *Lightning Bolt*
**1/day each:** *Cone of Cold*, *Mind Blank*, *Scrying*, *Teleport*

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) force damage.
